scope: One fixed train shard selected for bounded engineering feasibility, not random sampling of the full source corpus. No model training or expansion is authorized by a passing technical gate.
sampling_policy: Normalize and detect URL label conflicts before selection; deterministic hash ordering within each source label with a domain cap. Select before inspecting HTML; retain failures without replacements.
missing_metadata_policy: Unknown final URL, HTTP status, redirect history and source verification time stay null, never zero or assumed equal to input URL.
safety: Fetch only the fixed public dataset file. Offline parser never visits dataset URLs, executes scripts, opens a browser, submits forms or loads external resources. Public CI uploads aggregates and hashed source-row manifests only.
threshold_note: All numerical pilot gates are project engineering heuristics, not professor requirements.
